skill_name: List the tools needed to solder a circuit board.
workflow: The tools needed to solder a circuit board include: soldering iron, solder wire, flux, clippers, tweezers, desoldering braid, soldering tip cleaner, magnifying lamp, and a helping hands device. A soldering iron is used to heat up the connection and melt the solder so that it flows into the joint. Solder wire lets the melted solder attach to both components in the joint.
